reply: on falls with time roughly linearly (about -0.9 per second), and the sqrt(v) coefficient sits near 4.6–10 depending on what else is in the fit. I could not identify the second mixing term. A broad search over products of single-input functions and power laws in t, x and v did not reach an exact fit.

best.code:
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    return params[0]*np.sqrt(v) + params[1] + params[2]*t + params[3]*np.sqrt(x)*np.cos(v)
